plan: My value is $10. In a second-price auction, the optimal strategy is to bid my true value to maximize profit. My goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy in a second-price auction. This ensures I never pay more than my value and I win whenever my value is higher than the other bids. I will bid my value of $30.

This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with a second-price payment rule. My optimal strategy is to bid my true value. Bidding below my value risks losing to a bid I would have been happy to beat. Bidding above my value risks winning and paying more than my value, leading to a loss. Since my value is $25, I will bid $25.
